summary.whatChanges: Vitest's spy registry now stores mocks as WeakRefs with a FinalizationRegistry so uncalled mocks can be garbage collected. `clearAllMocks()` only clears mocks marked dirty (actually invoked, including their prototype mock), `resetAllMocks()` derefs and prunes dead entries, and docs raise the minimum Firefox version to 79.
behaviorChanges: vi.clearAllMocks() now skips mocks that have never been invoked, so mockClear is not called on them
Calling an instance mock also marks its prototype mock dirty, so clearAllMocks clears both
vi.resetAllMocks() skips/removes mocks already garbage collected
Mock instances are no longer strongly retained by the global registry, allowing GC
Documented browser support raises Firefox minimum from 78 to 79 (WeakRef/FinalizationRegistry)
risks: Requires WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry at runtime; older environments would throw
Dirty tracking only triggers on invocation, so mocks whose state is mutated some other way won't be cleared by clearAllMocks
DIRTY_MOCK_STATES holds strong references to called mocks and is only pruned in mockClear, so invoked mocks can still be retained
Subclass/prototype dirty marking depends on prototypeState lookup at creation time; mocks created before the prototype mock may not propagate
